passages.sermon:
David prayed to God.
David spoke honestly to God.
David trusted God.
David asked God for help.
David showed faith in God.

passages.text: Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.
passages.sermon:
David prays to the LORD.
David asks the LORD to hear his plea for justice.
David asks the LORD to listen to his cry.
David asks the LORD to pay attention to his prayer.
David says his prayer comes from honest lips.
David says his lips do not speak deceit.
passages.original: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שִׁמְעָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀ צֶ֗דֶק הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה רִנָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה תְפִלָּתִ֑י בְּ֝לֹ֗א שִׂפְתֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃

passages.text: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.
passages.sermon:
David prays to the LORD.
David asks God to judge him.
David wants God to decide his case.
David wants God to see what is right.
David asks God to look at what is true and just.
passages.original: מִ֭לְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים׃

passages.text: You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David says that God has examined his heart.
God has visited David during the night.
God has tested David.
God has found no evil in David.
David has decided not to sin with his mouth.
passages.original: בָּ֘חַ֤נְתָּ לִבִּ֨י׀ פָּ֘קַ֤דְתָּ לַּ֗יְלָה צְרַפְתַּ֥נִי בַל־ תִּמְצָ֑א זַ֝מֹּתִ֗י בַּל־ יַעֲבָר־ פִּֽי׃

passages.text: As for the deeds of men— by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.
passages.sermon:
God speaks with holy words.
People act in many ways.
I listen to God's words.
I avoid the path of violent people.
God's words guide me away from evil.
I choose to follow God's way, not the way of the violent.
passages.original: לִפְעֻלּ֣וֹת אָ֭דָם בִּדְבַ֣ר שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ אֲנִ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אָרְח֥וֹת פָּרִֽיץ׃

passages.text: My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.
passages.sermon:
God, You guide my steps.
You keep me walking in Your paths.
My feet do not slip.
You make me stand firm.
passages.original: תָּמֹ֣ךְ אֲ֭שֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶ֑יךָ בַּל־ נָמ֥וֹטּוּ פְעָמָֽי׃

passages.text: I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.
passages.sermon:
I call on You, God.
You answer me.
Turn Your ear to me.
Listen to my words.
passages.original: אֲנִֽי־ קְרָאתִ֣יךָ כִֽי־ תַעֲנֵ֣נִי אֵ֑ל הַֽט־ אָזְנְךָ֥ לִ֝֗י שְׁמַ֣ע אִמְרָתִֽי׃

passages.text: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.
passages.sermon:
God shows loving devotion.
God saves people who seek refuge.
God uses His right hand to save.
God rescues them from their enemies.
God’s loving devotion is wonderful.
passages.original: הַפְלֵ֣ה חֲ֭סָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ חוֹסִ֑ים מִ֝מִּתְקוֹמְמִ֗ים בִּֽימִינֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.
passages.sermon:
God, you are my protector.
Keep me safe.
Value me as the apple of your eye.
Hide me under the shadow of your wings.
Protect me from wicked people who attack me.
Save me from my enemies who surround me and seek my life.
passages.original: שָׁ֭מְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁ֣וֹן בַּת־ עָ֑יִן בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנִי׃ מִפְּנֵ֣י רְ֭שָׁעִים ז֣וּ שַׁדּ֑וּנִי אֹיְבַ֥י בְּ֝נֶ֗פֶשׁ יַקִּ֥יפוּ עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
passages.sermon:
The wicked have hard hearts.
They have closed their hearts to compassion.
They do not feel for others.
They speak with pride.
Their mouths speak arrogant words.

passages.text: They have tracked us down, and now surround us; their eyes are set to cast us to the ground, like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.
passages.sermon:
Wicked people have tracked us down.
Now they surround us.
They fix their eyes on us.
They want to throw us to the ground.
They act like a lion that is eager to catch its prey.
They are like a young lion hiding in secret places, waiting to attack.
passages.original: אַ֭שֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּ֣ה סְבָבוּנִי עֵינֵיהֶ֥ם יָ֝שִׁ֗יתוּ לִנְט֥וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ דִּמְיֹנ֗וֹ כְּ֭אַרְיֵה יִכְס֣וֹף לִטְר֑וֹף וְ֝כִכְפִ֗יר יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃

passages.text: Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword, from such men, O LORD, by Your hand— from men of the world whose portion is in this life. May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons, so they leave their abundance to their children.
passages.sermon:
David is the servant of the LORD.
David prays to God.
David says, “Arise, O LORD.”
David asks God to confront his enemies.
David asks God to bring his enemies to their knees.
David asks God to deliver him from wicked people.
David asks God to use His sword to save him.
David asks God to save him from men of the world.
These men have their portion in this life.
David asks God to fill the bellies of His treasured ones.
David asks God to satisfy the sons of His treasured ones.
David asks God to let them leave their abundance to their children.
passages.original: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה קַדְּמָ֣ה פָ֭נָיו הַכְרִיעֵ֑הוּ פַּלְּטָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מֵרָשָׁ֥ע חַרְבֶּֽךָ׃ מִֽמְתִ֥ים יָדְךָ֨׀ יְהוָ֡ה מִֽמְתִ֬ים מֵחֶ֗לֶד חֶלְקָ֥ם בַּֽחַיִּים֮ וּצְפִינְךָ תְּמַלֵּ֪א בִ֫טְנָ֥ם יִשְׂבְּע֥וּ בָנִ֑ים וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ יִ֝תְרָ֗ם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David is righteous.
David will see God's face.
David will see God because he is righteous.
When David awakes, he will be satisfied.
David will be satisfied with God's presence.
passages.original: אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭צֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶ֣ה פָנֶ֑יךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָ֥ה בְ֝הָקִ֗יץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃
